test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 12 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All men are robots.

All robots are machines.

**Conclusions:**

I. All machines are men.

II. Some robots are men.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
__**Venn diagram:**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/80eb760d1eea832e7d0f549bf2ea21ebe27316b77b5e378264d8af39e32e0f9f.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All machines are men → False (Because all men are robots and robots are machines so all men are also machines but not all machines are men)

II. Some robots are men → True (Because all men are robots so some robots are also men)

Hence, “**Only conclusion II follows**".
